content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing script that aligns model free-surface time to WG1 peak time (model peak and experimental peak scans at L16-L30 and L81-L95), loads modeled and measured A/B/C ADV velocity series (L35-L40, L51-L56, L100-L105, L116-L121), and draws four stacked U/V comparison panels (L42-L70, L107-L135). The A/B time base receives an additional -0.25 s offset at L32, while the C time base does not at L97.

equations.ref: A/B model time is translated from the modeled peak to the experimental peak and offset another 0.25 s
copy all modeled data columns except time into the preallocated velocity matrix
C model time is translated between peak times without the A/B offset
repeat C modeled velocity extraction before V panel

verbatim_spans.text: t=t-num_t_shift+exp_t_shift-0.25; % some difference between eta and u

unresolved: L38-L39, L54-L55, L103-L104, and L119-L120 preallocate exactly six velocity columns but copy nn-1 columns without checking nn-1<=6; an input with more than seven columns causes an assignment-size failure.
L43, L62, L108, and L127 index measured velocity rows 1:25 for the baseline mean without checking that each measured file has at least 25 rows.

The plot calls pair t derived from the FSE file (L11 or L76) with vel derived from separate VT files (L39,L55,L104,L120), but no equality check ensures matching vector lengths before L46,L65,L111,L130.

The V panel plots vel(:,2) at L130 after loading VT_C at L116-L120; if VT_C contains only time plus one velocity component, column 2 remains the zero-filled column from L119, so the script silently plots zeros rather than rejecting the missing component.

The two peak searches use exact equality to max (L17,L25,L82,L90) and take the first occurrence via break (L20,L28,L85,L93); tied maxima therefore select the earliest peak without documenting whether that is intended.
